Package net.sourceforge.plantuml.klimt.drawing.raster

Class ArcsToCubics

java.lang.Object
net.sourceforge.plantuml.klimt.drawing.raster.ArcsToCubics
All Implemented Interfaces:
RasterPath.Visitor
public abstract class ArcsToCubics extends Object implements RasterPath.Visitor
A RasterPath.Visitor for canvases that only know cubic Bézier curves: it turns the arcs into cubics (at most a quarter of a turn each), and keeps track of the current point, which SVG arcs start from.
